purpose: Root observations sent during active initial implementation, before candidate freeze/gates. Not a formal review, task acceptance, or separate fix-round dispatch. Recheck against final candidate; some have been addressed in changing source.

observations.requirement: Reconcile must fetch server-created merge objects before checking local object existence; the actual fetched ref/object must match provider identity.
Allow advanced remote M with changed task bytes only through fresh bound evidence/review/verification; preserve local I/L receipts.

Prove unique source/integration base, bounded first-parent range, every intermediate path delta and exact expected final tree. Empty edges are permitted by native architecture ruling. Derive source delta from source lineage rather than reversing unrelated I changes.

Persist executing before effects; concurrent calls do not reconcile/replay live writes. Exact effect adoption, same-process ended plus exact absence replay, fresh-process UNKNOWN and same-token replay must work.
Repeated proven/pending/ambiguous calls cannot allocate fresh writes; qualified premerge head/base change may supersede only linked unmerged attempts.
R with [advanced-base,H] parents requires advanced-base descent from M, exact M preimages on closure paths, exact H closure blobs and exact advanced-base entries elsewhere.

Only proved HANDOFF_BASE_RACE permits one replacement retry; ordinary polls, unrelated fetched tips and repeated reconciliation cannot spend another retry. Retain initial0 plus retry1/retry2 histories.
H2 and completion adoption must verify captured protected Git metadata, branch attachment and exact bytes, not merely capture an unused anchor.
Repeated preparation preserves the original token and before/after identities through local FF interruption; no reallocation or baseline reset.
Read bounded canonical validated records and actual completion proof; syntactically valid completion.status alone cannot release the native hold. Copied/rebound/malformed evidence remains UNKNOWN.
Retained legitimately complete remote records cannot permanently block subsequent remote stories through a blanket candidates.length>1 check.
Bind fetch/push destination and preserve strict ambiguous PR/CLEAN rules from earlier Fable triage.
Reject explicit tiny/small verificationReport=true before record creation; preserve standard opt-in and large/regulated required policy.
